# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-26 from the 2026-11-26 Hub dump.

- 3,271,572 models tracked, 947,417 declare a base model, 980,934 parent links, 94,309 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
